answer: If the relic is real, the basalt should agree with it; if the basalt agrees, the knoll should date them both; break one link and the chain is scrap metal. One agent spends 15 minutes and is done; the farm spends 3180 minutes and ends with nothing to sell. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. When the panel doubts all else, Tile maker charcoal black warrant glazed at the clay pit still holds, and it holds on each charcoal black is a season of logged firings plus a signed tilehouse record.
